observed_behavior: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 requires all content functionality to operate through a keyboard interface without individually timed keystrokes, except when the underlying function requires path-dependent movement input rather than only its endpoints. The criterion clarifies that the exception concerns the underlying function, not the input technique, and keyboard support does not preclude simultaneous mouse or other input methods.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024; exact criterion 2.1.1 Keyboard; focused W07 B1 K3 normative extraction. Level A; requirement and associated W3C notes/conditions only.
limitations: Path-dependent movement exception is about the underlying function; text entry by handwriting is not automatically exempt merely because a particular technique uses a movement path.
Does not require keyboard-only input or ban additional pointer methods.
Does not prescribe modal focus trapping, Escape behavior, initial focus, return focus, or a component-library implementation.
